name: Bug Reproduction Loop
description: Establish a reliable failure reproduction and bounded diagnosis before any implementation begins.
approval_boundaries: Do not edit production source during reproduction.
Escalate destructive, credentialed, or production-only reproduction steps.

phases.name: Symptom triage
phases.instructions: Classify the reported symptom and isolate relevant evidence.

phases.name: Reproduction context
phases.instructions: Find setup, commands, fixtures, and environmental constraints.

phases.name: Independent reproduction
phases.instructions: Produce the smallest reliable reproduction with exact output.

phases.name: Bounded diagnosis
phases.instructions: Form evidence-backed hypotheses without implementing a fix.

phases.name: Reproduction validation
phases.instructions: Confirm the reproduction command and evidence independently.

phases.name: Implementation handoff
phases.instructions: Hand off exact reproduction, diagnosis, scope, risks, and next action.
